mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review_report (id, review_job_id, overall_score, readiness, summary, strengths, major_risks, priorities, model_name, model_version, prompt_version, rubric_version, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{reviewJobId}, #{overallScore}, #{readiness}, #{summary}, #{strengths}::jsonb, #{majorRisks}::jsonb, #{priorities}::jsonb, #{modelName}, #{modelVersion}, #{promptVersion}, #{rubricVersion}, now())
mapper.select: SELECT id, review_job_id, overall_score, readiness, summary, strengths::text AS strengths, major_risks::text AS major_risks, priorities::text AS priorities, model_name, model_version, prompt_version, rubric_version, created_at FROM review_report WHERE review_job_id = #{reviewJobId}

SELECT id, review_job_id, overall_score, readiness, summary, strengths::text AS strengths, major_risks::text AS major_risks, priorities::text AS priorities, model_name, model_version, prompt_version, rubric_version, created_at FROM review_report WHERE id = #{id}
